Bash(# Fix 2: Create standard-name symlinks in each image directory
cd /tmp/ant-test/files/images && python3 << 'PYEOF'
import os, glob

for d in sorted\(os.listdir\('.'\)\):
    if not os.path.isdir\(d\) or d in \('icons', 'outpainted', 'panoramic', 'panoramic_v2'\):
        continue
    files = [f for f in os.listdir\(d\) if f.endswith\(\('.jpg', '.png', '.webp'\)\) and not os.path.islink\(os.path.join\(d, f\)\)]
    files.sort\(\)
    
    # Map: find hero-*, fig-*, content-*, footer-* and create standard names
    heroes = [f for f in files if 'hero' in f.lower\(\)]
    figs = [f for f in files if 'fig' in f.lower\(\) and 'fig1' not in f and 'fig2' not in f and 'fig3' not in f]
    contents = [f for f in files if 'content' in f.lower\(\)]
    footers = [f for f in files if 'footer' in f.lower\(\)]
    
    created = []
    # hero.jpg
    if heroes and not os.path.exists\(os.path.join\(d, 'hero.jpg'\)\):
        os.symlink\(heroes[0], os.path.join\(d, 'hero.jpg'\)\)
        created.append\(f'hero.jpg->{heroes[0]}'\)
    
    # content.jpg
    if contents and not os.path.exists\(os.path.join\(d, 'content.jpg'\)\):
        os.symlink\(contents[0], os.path.join\(d, 'content.jpg'\)\)
        created.append\(f'content.jpg->{contents[0]}'\)
    
    # footer.jpg
    if footers and not os.path.exists\(os.path.join\(d, 'footer.jpg'\)\):
        os.symlink\(footers[0], os.path.join\(d, 'footer.jpg'\)\)
        created.append\(f'footer.jpg->{footers[0]}'\)
    
    # fig1.jpg, fig2.jpg, fig3.jpg
    fig_sources = figs if figs else [f for f in files if f.startswith\('fig'\) and '-' in f]
    for i, src in enumerate\(fig_sources[:3], 1\):
        target = f'fig{i}.jpg'
        if not os.path.exists\(os.path.join\(d, target\)\):
            os.symlink\(src, os.path.join\(d, target\)\)
            created.append\(f'{target}->{src}'\)
    
    if created:
        print\(f"  {d}: {', '.join\(created\)}"\)

print\("Done"\)
PYEOF
)
